Frequently asked

What does 'quantum' mean here?

We simulate quantum-style parallelism - predictive routing, speculative deploys, and entangled failover - not literal qubits.

Can I bring my own domain?

Yes. Point your DNS to our Anycast edge. We generate and renew TLS automatically.

How is pricing calculated?

Plans are flat-rate by tier. Usage-based add-ons (edge functions, storage) are billed per unit with clear caps.
